common.alertTitle.context: Title of the generic error alert, whose message is the error text: save failures and every “Couldn’t …” message and messages.save.before.tryAgain routed to the window. The app's name (it was “Journal” before build 18). Not shown while locked; the lock screen shows the message instead.

common.back.context: Mac: returns from the password step to the first step (iPhone and iPad use the system back button). Also: Returns from the journal list to the choices.

common.blankEntry.context: First item of Default Template; checked when the journal has no default template. Also: Default Template value when none is set.

common.cancel.context: Cancel button in alerts, sheets and the template chooser.

common.chooseJournal.context: First choice and empty value of the Journal menu. Also: Heading of the journal list after Keep Entry… or Keep Entry as Copy…. Journals with changes to review aren’t listed; journals with the same name add their date, then an ID prefix.

common.chooseMasterPassword.context: Create-library sheet, password step heading. Also: Title of the step choosing a new master password (Connect to a Server, Turn On Encryption).

common.connect.context: Primary button after comparing check codes; Command-Return, never Return. Also: Primary button of Use a Recovery Code.

common.connectToServer.context: First-launch secondary action; opens the connection flow (flows/connect-to-server). Also: Button in Settings ▸ Sync, Devices and Agent Access when this device isn't connected. Opens Connect to a Server.

common.connecting.context: Agent row status while the agent finishes connecting. Also: Busy label while installing after a pairing was approved.

common.continue.context: Primary button that moves to the next step (Connect to a Server, Turn On Encryption, Add Device, Import Archive, Keep Your Recovery Key).

common.copy.context: Picture menu item (first on iPhone and iPad; after Cut on the Mac) and VoiceOver action: copies the original image. Also: Button copying the MCP address.

common.couldntReachHost.text: Couldn’t reach {host}. Check your connection and try again.
common.couldntReachHost.context: Turn On Encryption on its first step. Also: Allow Access, no connection (also when the request can't load).

common.couldntRevokeAccess.text: Couldn’t revoke access. Check your connection and try again.
common.couldntRevokeAccess.context: Detail when revoking failed. Also: Settings ▸ Devices when revoking failed; Try Again retries it.

common.create.context: Confirms New Journal (alert and sheet) and Choose a Master Password.

common.defaultTemplate.context: Journal context menu and Journal Actions submenu. Also: Field label.

common.delete.context: Destructive button in the delete and Delete Permanently alerts, and the trailing swipe action on an entry or template row (to Recently Deleted; in Recently Deleted it asks to delete permanently).

common.done.context: Closes a sheet after its action completed; on iPhone and iPad also the button that ends typing in an entry and ends the Journals list's edit mode (accessibility label of the checkmark).

text.one: 1 entry
text.other: {count} entries

common.entryCount.context: Number of entries: the Mac window subtitle under a journal's or All Entries' title; under a journal's or All Entries' name at accessibility text sizes (otherwise the bare number); part of the Delete All list; part of the On This Device summary in Merge Journals.

common.entryMovedNotDisplayed.text: The entry was moved, but couldn’t be displayed. Reopen My Journal to try again.
common.entryMovedNotDisplayed.context: Error alert after a stored move that couldn't be shown. Also: The change was committed when moving an entry finished, but reading the journals again for display failed.

common.exportArchive.context: File menu. Also: Button in Settings ▸ Backup, the Export Archive sheet, and the Erase warning.

common.format.context: Heading of the iPhone Format panel shown in place of the keyboard (also on iPad in compact width or at accessibility sizes). Also: Menu bar menu title (contents: screens/entry-editor).

common.importArchive.context: File menu. Also: First-launch action; opens the file picker for a .journalarchive file. Also: Button in Settings ▸ Backup.

text.one: 1 item
text.other: {count} items

common.itemCount.context: Number of items: the Mac window subtitle under Recently Deleted (journals, templates and entries), and the value of Not on Server Yet (entries, journals and templates all count as items).

text.one: 1 journal
text.other: {count} journals

common.journalCount.context: Number of journals: part of the Delete All list and of the On This Device summary in Merge Journals.

common.journalGone.text: That journal is no longer available. Choose another journal.
common.journalGone.context: Inline error (announced) when the chosen journal left; also Merge Into…. Also: Move Entry or Merge Into… when the chosen journal was deleted meanwhile (also JournalMergeError.destinationUnavailable).

common.journalNeedsReview.text: This journal has changes to review.
common.journalNeedsReview.context: Notice when the entry's journal has changes to review (with Review Changes). Also: Notice above an entry whose journal has changes to review.

common.journalNotArrived.text: This journal hasn’t arrived on this device.
common.journalNotArrived.context: Notice (and Restore Journal sheet) when the journal is missing and the library syncs. Also: Notice above an entry whose journal is missing, while this device syncs.

common.journalUnavailableEntrySaved.text: The journal for this entry is unavailable. Your entry is still saved.
common.journalUnavailableEntrySaved.context: Notice when the journal is missing and the library doesn't sync. Also: Notice above an entry whose journal is missing, on a device that doesn’t sync.

common.journals.context: iPhone root screen and iPad sidebar title (large); also the sidebar's accessibility label and the Journals section header. Also: Recently Deleted section header for deleted journals. Also: iPhone: title of the search results that replace the Journals list. Also: Location of a version in the Journals list. Also: Header (and accessibility label) of the journals choice.

common.lockMyJournal.context: Mac app menu, below Settings…, ⌃⌘L. Also: Button in the App Lock section while App Lock is on.

common.masterPassword.context: Password step, first secure field placeholder. Also: {credential} in settings.lock.useCredential, and the lock screen's credential field placeholder. Also: Master password field (Choose a Master Password, Turn On Encryption, Check Your Password).

common.merge.context: Confirming button. Also: Primary button of Merge Journals; Command-Return, never Return.

common.merging.context: Progress label. Also: Joining phase while this device's journals are merged and sent.

common.myJournalIsLocked.context: Label on the privacy cover, only while the journals are locked; while the app is merely inactive the cover is blank. Also: Heading of the lock screen.

common.name.context: Name field: the placeholder in New Journal, Rename Journal and Save as Template, the agent name field, and the field label in the journal version summary.

common.never.context: Access Ends choice. Also: Last Used value when never used. Also: Lock when inactive choice, last.

common.newJournalEllipsis.context: Button under the Journal menu; opens the New Journal sheet (screens/destination-journal.md). Also: Mac sidebar context menus, Mac Journal Actions menu, empty-list action, Move Entry. Also: File menu ⌥⌘N. Also: Creates a journal to keep the entry in.

common.onThisDevice.context: Location line of this device’s version. Also: Label of the row summarising this device's journals.

common.openSettings.context: Button in the Camera Access Is Off and Photos Access Is Off alerts; opens the app's page in the system settings. Also: Button opening the system's settings for My Journal when camera access is denied.

common.passwordOrRecoveryKey.context: Field for the archive's password. Also: Lock screen field placeholder when the credential's name isn't known.

common.pleaseWait.context: Restore sheet progress label. Also: Progress while the review is prepared or a choice is saved.

common.previewUnavailable.text: Preview isn’t available for this entry
common.previewUnavailable.context: Tooltip of the disabled View Source/Preview button for an entry that must be edited as Markdown. Also: Help tag of the dimmed View Preview / View Source control for such an entry.

common.privacyPolicy.context: Help menu; opens the privacy policy. Also: Settings ▸ About link to the privacy policy.

common.protectYourJournals.context: Create-library sheet, first step heading. Also: Title of the encryption choice when setting up a server from a device without journals.

common.rateMyJournal.context: Help menu; opens the App Store review page. Also: Settings ▸ About link to the store's review page.

common.recentlyDeleted.context: Sidebar row and collection title. Also: Location of a version in Recently Deleted.

common.recoveryCode.context: {credential} for a library set up with a one-time recovery code. Also: Recovery code field.

common.reloadJournals.context: Button after the chosen journal became unavailable during a restore. Also: Reads the conflict and journals again after the chosen journal became unavailable.

common.restore.context: Restore action: the context menu and Entry Actions of an item in Recently Deleted, the leading swipe on a row that can be restored directly, the recovery notice's action (restores the entry or template where it was), and the confirming button of Restore Entry and Restore and Move.

common.restoredAsRenamed.text: Another journal is named “{name}”, so this one will be restored as “{newName}”.
common.restoredAsRenamed.context: Restore sheet, when the name is taken; {newName} adds a number, such as “Work 2”. Also: Under Keep Journal when the name is taken; {newName} is the numbered name.

common.reviewChanges.context: Opens the review of changes made on two devices (handoff to the conflict review screens).

common.reviewChangesFor.context: Accessibility label of each Review Changes button in Settings ▸ Sync ▸ Changes to Review.

common.revokeAccess.context: Destructive button in the detail and its confirmation. Also: Destructive button of the revoke confirmation.

common.save.context: Confirms Save as Template and Change Date.

common.saveFailed.text: Couldn’t save “{title}”. Keep it open and try again.
common.saveFailed.context: Error alert message when the open entry couldn’t be saved; shown with Try Again and OK. {title} is the entry's title, its first line, or “New Entry”. Also: The open entry or template couldn’t be written to this device. {title} is its display title. Shown again after each failed attempt (typing, Try Again, navigating away).

common.saveFailedLocked.text: Couldn’t save your changes. Unlock My Journal to try again.
common.saveFailedLocked.context: The same failure while locked; the lock screen can show it, so it doesn't name the entry. Also: The save after locking failed; the lock screen shows this without naming the entry.

common.searchUnavailableEntries.context: Search prompt in Unavailable Journals. Also: Search field placeholder, help and label in Unavailable Journals.

common.serverAddress.context: Label of the row with the full server address on the Enter Code page. Also: Header and accessibility label of the server address field.

common.share.context: iPhone and iPad picture menu item: shows the share sheet with the original image. (The Mac uses the system's own Share item.) Also: iPhone and iPad: share the MCP address.

common.showPassword.context: Password step, toggle that shows both fields as plain text. Also: Switch showing the new password fields as plain text.

common.signIn.context: The single action for Needs you: opens Connect to a Server at this device’s server, which signs in straight away. Also: Settings ▸ Privacy button, and Turn On Encryption's primary, after encryption was turned on from another device.

text.one: 1 template
text.other: {count} templates

common.templateCount.context: Number of templates: the Mac window subtitle under Templates; part of the Delete All list and, when there are templates, of the On This Device summary in Merge Journals.

common.thisDevice.context: This device’s version, in the version choice and as the shown version’s heading. Also: Secondary line under this device's name.

common.tryAgain.context: Retries a failed action: a failed save (error alert and notice), a failed preparation (Restore Journal sheet), a sync, or a connection step.

common.trySyncingAgain.context: Action after “hasn’t arrived”: syncs now, retrying refused items. Also: Runs a sync that also resends refused items.

common.unavailableJournals.context: Sidebar row and collection title, shown only while there are unavailable entries or it is shown. Also: Sidebar row and list title of the collection of entries whose journal is missing, from a newer version, or has changes to review. Shown only while such entries exist or it is open.

common.unencryptedWarning.text: Anyone with access to your files, server, or backups can read your journals.
common.unencryptedWarning.context: Under Continue Without Encryption. Also: Detail under Don’t Encrypt. Also: Encryption footer for journals without encryption.

common.untitledJournal.context: Any journal whose name is blank: rows, titles, menus and alerts. Also: Name value for an unnamed journal.

common.updateToRestoreEntry.text: Update My Journal to restore this entry.
common.updateToRestoreEntry.context: Notice for an entry whose journal was saved by a newer version. Also: Notice above an entry whose journal was saved by a newer version.

common.verify.context: Password step, second secure field placeholder. Also: Second field confirming a new master password.

common.version.context: Caption of the Version menu (above the chosen version's time). Also: Label of the This Device / Other Device choice.

common.versionHistoryEllipsis.context: Context menu and Entry Actions (screens/version-history). Also: Journal context menu and Journal Actions (screens/journal-history).

editor.announce.bulletedList.context: VoiceOver announcement after “- ” (or “* ”, “+ ”) makes a bulleted list; also the Undo step's name.

editor.announce.checklist.context: VoiceOver announcement after “[ ] ” or “[x] ” makes a checklist item; also the Undo step's name.

editor.announce.codeBlock.context: VoiceOver announcement after “```” and Return makes a code block.

editor.announce.copied.context: VoiceOver announcement after a picture's Copy.

editor.announce.decreaseIndent.context: VoiceOver announcement after Backspace moves a nested item out a level.

editor.announce.heading.context: VoiceOver announcement after “# ” … “###### ” makes a heading; also the Undo step's name.

editor.announce.horizontalRule.context: VoiceOver announcement after “---” and Return makes a rule.

editor.announce.imageAdded.context: VoiceOver announcement after Insert Image added one image.

editor.announce.imageDeleted.context: VoiceOver announcement shortly after a picture's Delete.

editor.announce.imagesAdded.context: VoiceOver announcement after Insert Image added several images.

editor.announce.level.context: VoiceOver announcement after Increase or Decrease Indent: the item's new level, 1 at the top.

editor.announce.numberedList.context: VoiceOver announcement after “1. ” makes a numbered list; also the Undo step's name.

editor.announce.paragraph.context: VoiceOver announcement after Backspace removes an item's or quote's formatting.

editor.announce.savedToPhotos.context: VoiceOver announcement after Save to Photos.

editor.body.accessibilityLabel.context: Accessibility label of the entry's body text.

editor.body.placeholder.context: Placeholder of an empty body, laid out as body text, when no template can be offered.

editor.body.placeholder.templateLink.context: Underlined link in the accent colour after editor.body.placeholder.templatePrefix, preceded by a template symbol; opens the template chooser. Lower case because it continues the sentence. VoiceOver reads library.templateChooser.useTemplate instead.

editor.body.placeholder.templatePrefix.context: Start of the empty body's placeholder when templates exist; followed by the template symbol and the link editor.body.placeholder.templateLink. Ends with a space.

editor.format.close.context: Accessibility label of the Format panel's round close (×) button.

editor.format.exitCodeBlock.context: Formatting surface row shown only while the caret is in a code block; moves the caret to the block after it.

editor.format.moreHeadings.context: Formatting surface row that opens a menu with Heading 4, Heading 5 and Heading 6.

editor.format.state.mixed.context: Accessibility value of an inline style toggle when part of the selection has the style.

editor.format.state.off.context: Accessibility value of an inline style toggle when the selection doesn't have the style.

editor.format.state.on.context: Accessibility value of an inline style toggle (Bold, Italic…) in the Formatting surface when the whole selection has the style.

editor.history.chooseVersion.context: Value of the Version menu when no version is chosen.

editor.history.createJournalFirst.text: Create a journal to restore this version.
editor.history.createJournalFirst.context: Shown instead of the Journal menu when there are no journals in use.

editor.history.empty.context: Shown in secondary text when the item has no earlier versions.

editor.history.journalDuplicate.context: A journal in the Journal menu whose name another journal shares: its name, its creation date and time, and its number among them.

editor.history.journalLabel.context: Caption of the Journal menu choosing where an entry version is restored.

editor.history.loading.context: Progress label while earlier versions load.

editor.history.loadingJournals.context: Progress label while Reload Journals runs.

editor.history.reload.context: Button after a failed load, or when the chosen version is no longer available.

editor.history.restoreAsNewEntry.context: Button restoring the chosen entry version as a new entry in the chosen journal.

editor.history.restoreAsNewTemplate.context: Button restoring the chosen template version as a new template.

editor.history.restored.text: The version was restored. Reopen it from your journal.
editor.history.restored.context: Shown when the restored entry couldn't be displayed.

editor.history.restoredTemplate.text: The version was restored. Reopen it from Templates.
editor.history.restoredTemplate.context: Shown when the restored template couldn't be displayed.

editor.history.restoring.context: Progress label while a version is restored.

editor.history.title.context: Title of the Version History sheet for an entry or template.

editor.history.updateToRestore.text: Update My Journal to restore this version.
editor.history.updateToRestore.context: Shown in place of the preview for a version in a format this version can't read, with Export Archive….

editor.history.versionDuplicate.context: Name of a version whose time reads the same as another's; {time} is the abbreviated date and time with seconds, {number} counts them from 1 in list order.

editor.image.accessibilityLabel.context: Accessibility label of a shown picture without a description.

editor.image.copyFailed.context: Error alert message when a picture's original can't be read for Copy or Cut.

editor.image.cut.context: Mac picture menu item: copies the original image and removes the picture.

editor.image.describeSpoken.context: VoiceOver action name for opening Image Descriptions from a picture (no ellipsis). The menu item is library.entryActions.imageDescriptions.

editor.image.fileName.context: Name given to a shared or saved picture's file, followed by its type's extension (Image.jpeg). Never the description.

editor.image.loading.context: Placeholder line drawn in place of a picture whose file is still being read or downloaded. Also: Progress label in place of an image preview still loading in the Image Descriptions sheet.

editor.image.loadingAccessibility.context: Start of the accessibility label of a picture still loading; followed by its description, if any.

editor.image.paste.context: Mac picture menu item: pastes over the selected picture.

editor.image.photosOff.message.text: Allow photo library access in Settings to save images.
editor.image.photosOff.message.context: Alert message after Save to Photos when photo library access is denied.

editor.image.photosOff.title.context: Alert title after Save to Photos when photo library access is denied.

editor.image.remote.context: Placeholder drawn in place of an image whose address isn't one of the journal's attachments (from Markdown written elsewhere); it's never downloaded.

editor.image.remoteAccessibility.context: Start of the accessibility label of a remote image; followed by its description, if any.

editor.image.saveFailed.context: Mac error alert message when Save Image As… can't read or write the file.

editor.image.saveImageAs.context: Mac picture menu item: a save panel for the original image.

editor.image.saveImageAsSpoken.context: Mac VoiceOver action name for saving a picture (no ellipsis).

editor.image.saveToPhotos.context: iPhone and iPad picture menu item and VoiceOver action: saves the original to the photo library.

editor.image.saveToPhotosFailed.text: The image couldn’t be saved to Photos.
editor.image.saveToPhotosFailed.context: iPhone and iPad error alert message when Save to Photos fails.

editor.image.shareFailed.context: Error alert message when a picture's original can't be read for Share.

editor.image.shareSpoken.context: VoiceOver action name for sharing a picture (no ellipsis).

editor.image.unavailable.context: Placeholder line drawn in place of a picture whose file isn't on this device.

editor.image.unavailableAccessibility.context: Start of the accessibility label of a picture whose file isn't here; followed by its description, if any.

editor.imageDescriptions.copy.context: Button copying every description as plain text (“Image 1”, a new line, the description, a blank line…).

editor.imageDescriptions.discardTitle.context: Confirmation dialog title before Reload Images throws away typed descriptions.

editor.imageDescriptions.fieldLabel.context: Accessibility label of each image's description field.

editor.imageDescriptions.image.context: Heading above the only image in the Image Descriptions sheet.

editor.imageDescriptions.imageNumber.context: Heading above each image when the entry has several; also starts each image in Copy Descriptions.

editor.imageDescriptions.imageUnavailabl.context: Shown with a photo symbol in place of an image preview that can't be shown.

editor.imageDescriptions.intro.text: Describe what matters in each image. Descriptions help people using VoiceOver.
editor.imageDescriptions.intro.context: Introduction at the top of the Image Descriptions sheet, in secondary text.

editor.imageDescriptions.keepEditing.context: Cancel button of the discard dialog.

editor.imageDescriptions.loadingImages.context: Progress label while Reload Images reloads the entry.

editor.imageDescriptions.noLongerAvailab.text: This entry is no longer available for editing. Your description changes are still here.
editor.imageDescriptions.noLongerAvailab.context: Shown when the entry stopped being describable while the sheet was open (deleted, moved out, conflict, read-only). Done is disabled; the fields stay.

editor.imageDescriptions.placeholder.context: Placeholder of each image's description field.

editor.imageDescriptions.previewLabel.context: Accessibility label of an image preview in the Image Descriptions sheet, with the description as typed so far (empty when none).

editor.imageDescriptions.previewLoading.context: Accessibility label of a preview still loading; {label} is editor.imageDescriptions.previewLabel.

editor.imageDescriptions.previewUnavaila.context: Accessibility label of a preview that can't be shown; {label} is editor.imageDescriptions.previewLabel.

editor.imageDescriptions.reload.context: Button after an error or when the entry changed: reloads the entry's images and descriptions. Also the destructive button of the discard dialog.

editor.imageDescriptions.savedNotShown.text: The descriptions were saved, but couldn’t be displayed. Reopen My Journal to try again.
editor.imageDescriptions.savedNotShown.context: Shown when the descriptions were saved but the view couldn't refresh.

editor.imageDescriptions.saving.context: Progress label while the descriptions are saved.

editor.imageDescriptions.title.context: Title of the Image Descriptions sheet.

editor.imageImport.adding.context: Notice above the writing while one chosen image is read (after 0.5 s), with a small progress indicator and Stop.

editor.imageImport.addingAccessibility.context: Accessibility label of the one-image progress notice.

editor.imageImport.addingSeveral.context: Notice above the writing while several chosen images are read, e.g. “Adding Images… 2 of 5”.

editor.imageImport.addingSeveralAccessib.context: Accessibility label of the several-images progress notice; its value is editor.imageImport.progressValue.

editor.imageImport.allFailed.text: None of the {total} images could be added.

editor.imageImport.cause.mixed.text: Try again, or choose other images.

editor.imageImport.progressValue.context: Accessibility value of the several-images progress notice.

editor.imageImport.stop.context: Button in the image import notice; ends the import and inserts nothing.

text.other: The images weren’t added because this entry can’t be changed right now.

editor.imageImport.unchangeable.context: Shown when the entry stays open but stops being editable (or the library is replaced) before the chosen images were read. editor.imageImport.left is now only for leaving the entry.

editor.insertImage.cameraOff.message.text: Allow camera access in Settings to take photos.
editor.insertImage.cameraOff.message.context: Alert message after Take Photo when camera access is denied.

editor.insertImage.cameraOff.title.context: Alert title after Take Photo when camera access is denied in Settings.

editor.insertImage.chooseFile.context: iPhone and iPad Insert Image menu, last item: Files, image files, several at once.

editor.insertImage.photoLibrary.context: iPhone and iPad Insert Image menu, first item: the system photo picker (several photos, in the order chosen).

editor.insertImage.takePhoto.context: iPhone and iPad Insert Image menu: the camera. Hidden on devices without a usable camera.
