messages.conflict.deletion.keepDeletionE.context: Under Keep Deletion… for a journal, and in its confirmation.

messages.conflict.deletion.keepDeletionE.text: Removes this edited version and its earlier versions from My Journal.
messages.conflict.deletion.keepDeletionE.context: Under Keep Deletion… for an entry or template, and in its confirmation.

messages.conflict.deletion.keepEntry.context: Edited entry against a deletion: keep the edited entry in a journal chosen next.

messages.conflict.deletion.keepEntryAsCo.context: Keep the edited entry as a new entry in a journal chosen next.

messages.conflict.deletion.keepEntryAsCo.text: Creates a new entry and keeps the original deleted. Any remaining earlier versions stay available in archive exports.

messages.conflict.deletion.keepEntryExpl.text: Keeps the edited entry. Earlier versions already deleted aren’t restored.

messages.conflict.deletion.keepJournal.context: Edited journal against a deletion: keeps it at once.

messages.conflict.deletion.keepJournalEx.text: Keeps this journal’s name and template. Deleted entries aren’t restored.

messages.conflict.deletion.keepTemplate.context: Edited template against a deletion: keeps it at once.

messages.conflict.deletion.keepTemplateE.text: Keeps the edited template. Earlier versions already deleted aren’t restored.

messages.conflict.deletion.receivedVersi.context: Location line of the received version.

messages.conflict.deletion.remainingVers.text: Any remaining earlier versions will be removed from My Journal on this device.
messages.conflict.deletion.remainingVers.context: Confirmation when both versions are deletions.

messages.conflict.deletion.reviewAgain.context: Reads the conflict again after an error.

messages.conflict.deletion.savedNotDispl.text: Your choice was saved, but My Journal couldn’t update the view. Reopen My Journal to continue.
messages.conflict.deletion.savedNotDispl.context: The choice was saved but reading the journals again failed.

messages.conflict.deletion.unknownDevice.context: Device line of each version (no device name is known).

messages.conflict.deletion.updateToRevie.text: Update My Journal to review these changes. You can export an archive to keep a copy.
messages.conflict.deletion.updateToRevie.context: A version can’t be read by this version of My Journal.

messages.conflict.entryNotice.text: This entry has changes from another device.
messages.conflict.entryNotice.context: Notice above an entry or template that has changes to review (above the writing on every platform). Also JournalError.conflict’s description.

messages.conflict.journal.chooseOne.text: Choose one version of this journal. Its entries will stay in the same journal.
messages.conflict.journal.chooseOne.context: The store refuses Keep Both for a journal. Never shown: the journal review only offers Keep Version….

messages.conflict.journal.confirmMessage.text: {date}. Both versions will remain in Version History.
messages.conflict.journal.confirmMessage.context: Confirmation message; {date} is the version’s modification date and time (abbreviated date, standard time).

messages.conflict.journal.confirmOtherDe.text: Keep the version from Other Device?
messages.conflict.journal.confirmOtherDe.context: Confirmation title when Other Device is shown.

messages.conflict.journal.confirmThisDev.text: Keep the version from This Device?
messages.conflict.journal.confirmThisDev.context: Confirmation title when This Device is shown.

messages.conflict.journal.details.context: Disclosure under Other Device that shows the recorded device ID (lower-case, selectable).

messages.conflict.journal.deviceIDLabel.context: Accessibility label of the device ID.

messages.conflict.journal.errorLabel.context: Accessibility label of the journal review’s error text.

messages.conflict.journal.keepVersion.context: Journal review: keeps the shown version, after confirmation. There is no Keep Both for journals.

messages.conflict.journal.reload.context: Retries reading after a saved choice.

messages.conflict.journal.reloadChanges.context: Reads the conflict again after an error before a choice was saved.

messages.conflict.journal.saved.context: Journal review after a successful choice.

messages.conflict.journal.savedNotDispla.text: Your choice was saved, but the journal couldn’t be displayed.
messages.conflict.journal.savedNotDispla.context: Journal review: saved, but reading the journals again failed.

messages.conflict.journal.value.unavaila.context: Default Template value when the template isn’t on this device.

messages.conflict.keepBoth.context: Primary action in an entry or template review: keeps both versions as separate items.

messages.conflict.keepBothNote.entries.text: Keep Both saves the versions as separate entries.
messages.conflict.keepBothNote.entries.context: Note above Keep Both for an entry.

messages.conflict.keepBothNote.templates.text: Keep Both saves the versions as separate templates.
messages.conflict.keepBothNote.templates.context: Note above Keep Both for a template.

messages.conflict.keepBothOutcome.date.context: Added when the versions have different entry dates.

messages.conflict.keepBothOutcome.place.text: Each version stays where it is.
messages.conflict.keepBothOutcome.place.context: Added after the Keep Both note when the versions are in different places (journal, Recently Deleted or archive).

messages.conflict.keepBothOutcome.placeA.text: Each version keeps its place and date.

messages.conflict.keepOne.context: Menu with the two single-version choices.

messages.conflict.keepOne.history.text: The original versions will remain in Version History.
messages.conflict.keepOne.history.context: Confirmation message; for Other Device it follows an outcome line when keeping it moves or redates the entry.

messages.conflict.keepOne.title.context: Confirmation title for Keep Version from This Device… or Other Device….

messages.conflict.keepOtherDevice.context: Item of Keep One Version; asks for confirmation.

messages.conflict.keepThisDevice.context: Item of Keep One Version; asks for confirmation.

messages.conflict.keepVersion.context: Confirming button in every keep-one-version confirmation (entries and journals).

messages.conflict.locked.text: Unlock My Journal to review changes.
messages.conflict.locked.context: Review sheet content when the journals locked while it was open (the sheet then closes).

messages.conflict.needsReview.context: Accessibility label of the exclamation mark on an entry row with changes to review, and visible text in a journal’s settings section.

messages.conflict.outcome.entry.archiveI.text: The entry will be archived in {journal}.
messages.conflict.outcome.entry.archiveI.context: Confirmation when that version of the entry was archived by an earlier version of My Journal.

messages.conflict.outcome.entry.archiveI.text: The entry will be archived in {journal}, and its date will change to {date}.
messages.conflict.outcome.entry.archiveI.context: Archived place and date both differ.

messages.conflict.outcome.entry.dateChan.text: The entry’s date will change to {date}.
messages.conflict.outcome.entry.dateChan.context: Confirmation when only the entry’s date differs; {date} is the abbreviated date, for example “1 Oct 2026”.

messages.conflict.outcome.entry.moveTo.context: Confirmation when that version of the entry is in another place; {journal} is its journal name (“Untitled Journal” when unnamed).

messages.conflict.outcome.entry.moveToAn.text: The entry will move to {journal}, and its date will change to {date}.

messages.conflict.outcome.entry.moveToRe.text: The entry will move to Recently Deleted.
messages.conflict.outcome.entry.moveToRe.context: Confirmation for Keep Version from Other Device… when that version of the entry is in Recently Deleted and this one isn’t.

messages.conflict.outcome.entry.moveToRe.text: The entry will move to Recently Deleted, and its date will change to {date}.

messages.conflict.outcome.template.archi.text: The template will be archived in {journal}.
messages.conflict.outcome.template.archi.context: Confirmation when that version of the template was archived by an earlier version of My Journal.

messages.conflict.outcome.template.archi.text: The template will be archived in {journal}, and its date will change to {date}.
messages.conflict.outcome.template.archi.context: Archived place and date both differ.

messages.conflict.outcome.template.dateC.text: The template’s date will change to {date}.
messages.conflict.outcome.template.dateC.context: Confirmation when only the template’s date differs; {date} is the abbreviated date, for example “1 Oct 2026”.

messages.conflict.outcome.template.moveT.context: Confirmation when that version of the template is in another place; {journal} is its journal name (“Untitled Journal” when unnamed), or “Templates”.

messages.conflict.outcome.template.moveT.text: The template will move to {journal}, and its date will change to {date}.
The template will move to Recently Deleted.
messages.conflict.outcome.template.moveT.context: Confirmation for Keep Version from Other Device… when that version of the template is in Recently Deleted and this one isn’t.

messages.conflict.outcome.template.moveT.text: The template will move to Recently Deleted, and its date will change to {date}.

messages.conflict.placement.archivedIn.context: As above, for a version archived by an earlier version of My Journal.

messages.conflict.placement.dated.context: Line when only the entry dates differ.

messages.conflict.placement.inJournal.context: Line under the shown version’s date when the versions are in different places; {journal} is its journal (“Untitled Journal” when unnamed).

messages.conflict.placement.inRecentlyDe.context: As above, for a version in Recently Deleted.

messages.conflict.placement.inTemplates.context: As above, for a template version.

messages.conflict.resolved.context: Review sheet when the conflict no longer exists (resolved here or on another device).

messages.conflict.savingChanges.context: Progress while a choice is saved (entry and journal reviews).

messages.conflict.settingsSection.context: Header of the section in Settings ▸ Sync that lists every record with changes to review, shown only when there is one and the app is unlocked.

messages.conflict.status.refreshFailed.context: Entry review: reading the changed versions again failed; previews and choices are hidden.

messages.conflict.status.updated.text: These changes were updated. Review both versions again.
messages.conflict.status.updated.context: Entry review: the other device’s version changed while the review was open, or a choice was refused because it changed. The choice is cleared and This Device is shown.

messages.conflict.updateToReview.text: Update My Journal to review these changes.
messages.conflict.updateToReview.context: Review sheet when either version has content this version can’t read (unsupported conflict).

messages.conflict.updatedReviewAgain.text: These changes have been updated. Review them again.
messages.conflict.updatedReviewAgain.context: Journal or deletion review: the versions changed since the review was read; the choice wasn’t applied.

messages.conflict.updatingChanges.context: Progress while the entry review reads the versions again.

messages.conflict.version.hintOtherDevic.context: Accessibility hint of the preview while Other Device is shown.

messages.conflict.version.hintThisDevice.context: Accessibility hint of the read-only preview while This Device is shown.

messages.connection.alreadyConnected.text: This device is already connected to this server.
messages.connection.alreadyConnected.context: Connecting again to the server this device is connected to, when nothing needs repairing.

messages.connection.alreadyConnecting.text: A connection is already being set up.
messages.connection.alreadyConnecting.context: Starting a second connection while one is being set up.

messages.connection.alreadyHasJournals.context: Joining as an empty device after journals were written meanwhile.

messages.connection.cannotConnect.text: Couldn’t connect to the server. Check your connection and try again.
messages.connection.cannotConnect.context: Connect to a Server: a network error (no connection, refused, timed out, not found, certificate).

messages.connection.cannotConnectTailsca.text: Couldn’t connect to the server. If it uses Tailscale, turn on Tailscale on this device and try again.

messages.connection.chooseUpload.text: Choose whether to upload your local journals before connecting.
messages.connection.chooseUpload.context: Connecting a library with journals before Merge Journals was agreed (a guard; the flow asks first).

messages.connection.connectedNotDisplaye.text: The server is connected, but your journals couldn’t be displayed. Reopen My Journal to try again.
messages.connection.connectedNotDisplaye.context: Joining succeeded but reading the journals for display failed.

messages.connection.createFailed.text: Couldn’t create your journal. Try again.
messages.connection.createFailed.context: Setting up a server from a device with no library, when creating the library failed without its own message.

messages.connection.createJournalFirst.text: Create a journal before setting up your server.
messages.connection.createJournalFirst.context: Setting up a server with no library (a guard; the flow creates one first).

messages.connection.credentialIncorrect.context: Signing in or setting up with an existing password: the credential is wrong. {credential} is “password” for any kind of password, or “recovery key” / “recovery code”.

messages.connection.credentialRateLimite.text: Too many {credential} attempts on this server. Try again in a few minutes, or use a connected device.
messages.connection.credentialRateLimite.context: Signing in: the server rate-limited attempts. {credential} as in messages.connection.credentialIncorrect.

messages.connection.encryptionOff.text: Encryption is off for this server, so it can’t store your encrypted journals. Connect to a server that uses encryption.
messages.connection.encryptionOff.context: ServerConnectionError.encryptionOff, shown as is only when finishing a pairing. Checking the address shows messages.connection.encryptionOffOnHost instead.

messages.connection.encryptionOffOnHost.text: The journals on this device are encrypted, but {host} doesn’t use encryption. Turn on encryption in Settings > Privacy on a connected device, then try again.
messages.connection.encryptionOffOnHost.context: Connect to a Server, checking an address whose server stores journals without encryption while this library is encrypted.

messages.connection.finishFailed.context: Finishing Add This Device failed on a device with no library.

messages.connection.finishFailedLocal.text: Couldn’t finish connecting. Your local journals remain on this device.
messages.connection.finishFailedLocal.context: Finishing Add This Device failed otherwise.

messages.connection.finishFailedRetry.text: Couldn’t finish connecting. Your local journals remain on this device. Try again, or cancel to keep writing.
messages.connection.finishFailedRetry.context: Finishing Add This Device failed while a staged copy waits for Try Again (writing is paused).

messages.connection.invalidRecoveryCode.text: That recovery code isn’t valid. Check it and try again.
messages.connection.invalidRecoveryCode.context: ServerConnectionError.invalidRecoveryCode. Never shown: signing in shows messages.connection.recoveryCodeIncorrect instead.

messages.connection.mergeFailed.text: Couldn’t finish connecting. Your journals are still on this device. Try again, or cancel to keep writing.
messages.connection.mergeFailed.context: Merging this device’s journals with the server stopped before anything was sent.

messages.connection.mergeFailedSent.text: Couldn’t finish connecting. Your journals are still on this device, and some may already be on {host}. Try again, or cancel to keep writing.
messages.connection.mergeFailedSent.context: Merging stopped after sending had started.

messages.connection.notJournalServer.text: This address doesn’t lead to a My Journal server. Check it and try again.
messages.connection.notJournalServer.context: Connect to a Server: the address answers, but not as a journal server.

messages.connection.pairingDeclined.text: Your connected device didn’t add this one.
messages.connection.pairingDeclined.context: Adding this device with a scanned code: the connected device declined.

messages.connection.pairingExpired.text: This code has expired. Show a new code on your connected device.
messages.connection.pairingExpired.context: Adding this device with a scanned code: the code expired.

messages.connection.pairingInsecure.text: Couldn’t add this device securely. Show a new code on your connected device and try again.
messages.connection.pairingInsecure.context: Adding this device with a scanned code: the received grant failed its security check.

messages.connection.passwordsDontMatch.context: Choosing a master password while setting up a server: the two fields differ. (Turn On Encryption uses the same text.)

messages.connection.reconnectSameServer.text: Reconnect to the same server to keep your journals together.
messages.connection.reconnectSameServer.context: Connecting to another address while this device is connected. (To move servers: Stop Syncing, then connect.)

messages.connection.recoveryCodeIncorrec.text: That recovery code isn’t correct or has already been used.
messages.connection.recoveryCodeIncorrec.context: Signing in with a server’s one-time recovery code: wrong, already used, or not a recovery code at all.

messages.connection.serverChanged.text: This server has changed since you checked it. Choose Continue to check it again.
messages.connection.serverChanged.context: ServerConnectionError.serverChanged: the server’s recovery envelope changed between checking it and signing in, setting up or finishing a pairing. The flow returns to the address step.

messages.connection.serverNeedsUpdateFor.text: This server needs an update before you can add devices this way.
messages.connection.serverNeedsUpdateFor.context: Adding this device with a scanned code to a server without check-code pairing.

messages.connection.setUpElsewhere.text: This server has just been set up. Choose it again to sign in.
messages.connection.setUpElsewhere.context: Setting up failed because another device set the server up meanwhile; the flow returns to the address.

messages.connection.setupCodeCharacters.text: Setup codes use letters and the digits 2–9, without I or O.
messages.connection.setupCodeCharacters.context: Set Up Server: the typed code has characters a setup code never uses.

messages.connection.setupCodeIncorrect.text: That setup code isn’t correct. Check the code on your server.
messages.connection.setupCodeIncorrect.context: Set Up Server: the server refused the setup code.

messages.connection.setupCodeLength.text: Enter the 6-character setup code from your server.
messages.connection.setupCodeLength.context: Set Up Server: the typed code doesn’t have 6 characters.

messages.connection.setupCodeRateLimited.text: Too many incorrect codes. Try again in a few minutes.
messages.connection.setupCodeRateLimited.context: Set Up Server: the server rate-limited setup codes.

messages.connection.setupFailedSaved.text: Your journal is saved on this device, but the server couldn’t be set up. {message}
messages.connection.setupFailedSaved.context: Setting up a server from a device that just created its first journal in the same flow; {message} is the failure’s own message.

messages.connection.updateApp.text: Update My Journal to connect to this server.
messages.connection.updateApp.context: Connect to a Server: the server speaks a newer protocol, or a scanned pairing needs a newer app.

messages.deleteConflict.journal.text: This journal has changes that need review.
messages.deleteConflict.journal.context: Message of the alert for a journal. Buttons: common.reviewChanges and common.cancel.

messages.deleteConflict.record.text: This has changes that need review before it can be deleted.
messages.deleteConflict.record.context: Message of the alert for an entry, template or other record in Recently Deleted. Buttons: common.reviewChanges and common.cancel.

messages.deleteConflict.title.context: Title of the alert when Delete Journal or Delete Permanently finds changes to review. {name} is the title in curly quotes, shortened in the middle with an ellipsis past 40 characters; a blank title reads common.untitledJournal, library.entryList.untitledTemplate or library.entryList.untitledEntryInAlert.

messages.encryption.accessLost.text: This device no longer has access to {host}. Connect again in Settings > Devices, then try again.
messages.encryption.accessLost.context: Turn On Encryption: the server refused this device.

messages.encryption.announce.updatingSer.text: Updating {host}. You can’t stop this now.
messages.encryption.announce.updatingSer.context: VoiceOver announcement when the server update starts.

messages.encryption.background.text: Encryption stopped because My Journal was in the background. Keep My Journal open and try again.
messages.encryption.background.context: Turn On Encryption on iPhone and iPad when background time ran out.

messages.encryption.failed.text: Encryption wasn’t turned on. Your journals are unchanged.
messages.encryption.failed.context: Turn On Encryption: any other failure.

messages.encryption.imagesMissing.text: Some images haven’t downloaded to this device yet. Keep My Journal open for a moment, then try again.

messages.encryption.incorrectPassword.context: Turn On Encryption, current server password field.

messages.encryption.notEnoughSpace.text: There isn’t enough space to encrypt your journals. Free up {size} and try again.
messages.encryption.notEnoughSpace.context: Turn On Encryption; {size} is a file size such as “120 MB”.

messages.encryption.rateLimited.text: Too many password attempts on this server. Try again in a few minutes.
messages.encryption.rateLimited.context: Turn On Encryption, current server password field.

messages.encryption.serverOutdated.text: {host} needs an update before you can turn on encryption.
messages.encryption.serverOutdated.context: Turn On Encryption: the server lacks encryption support; {host} is the host name with its first letter capitalized.

messages.encryption.stillSyncing.text: Your other devices are still syncing. Wait for them to finish, then try again.
messages.encryption.stillSyncing.context: Turn On Encryption: other devices’ changes are still arriving, or the server changed meanwhile.

messages.encryption.turnedOnElsewhere.text: Encryption was turned on from another device. Sign in to keep syncing.
messages.encryption.turnedOnElsewhere.context: Settings ▸ Privacy ▸ Encryption footer while sign-in is offered, and Turn On Encryption’s error when the server switched to encryption meanwhile. Sync itself says messages.sync.signInNeeded.

messages.encryption.unfinished.text: Your journals are encrypted on {host}, but this device couldn’t finish. Free up space, then try again.
messages.encryption.unfinished.context: Turn On Encryption: the server was updated but this device couldn’t re-encrypt its copy.

messages.encryption.unreachable.text: Couldn’t reach {host}. Encryption wasn’t turned on. Check your connection and try again.
messages.encryption.unreachable.context: Turn On Encryption after its first step.

messages.entry.archiveChanged.text: This entry’s archive status changed. Review it before trying again.
messages.entry.archiveChanged.context: EntryArchivingError.changed. Archiving was removed; nothing calls it.

messages.entry.copyLocation.text: Choose a new location for the journal copy.
messages.entry.copyLocation.context: Restoring a journal copy without a new location (a guard).

messages.entry.dateChanged.text: This entry’s date changed. Close this sheet and try again.

messages.entry.imagesChanged.text: This entry has changed. Review its images again.

messages.entry.moveNeedsReview.text: Review this entry’s changes before moving it.
messages.entry.moveNeedsReview.context: Move Entry for an entry with changes to review.

messages.entry.unavailableForEditing.text: This entry is no longer available for editing.
messages.entry.unavailableForEditing.context: EntryDateError / ImageDescriptionError / EntryArchivingError .unavailable: the entry was deleted or moved meanwhile.

messages.error.invalidAddress.text: Enter a valid HTTPS server address.
messages.error.invalidAddress.context: JournalError.invalidAddress: the server address typed isn’t a valid HTTPS address.

messages.error.invalidData.context: JournalError.invalidData: a record, archive or server answer that can’t be decoded, where an operation reports its error directly (archive import, connecting). In sync it becomes messages.sync.unexpected.

messages.error.invalidRecoveryKey.text: That password or recovery key couldn’t unlock your journals.
messages.error.invalidRecoveryKey.context: JournalError.invalidRecoveryKey where no more specific text applies: unlocking with the password or recovery key on the lock screen, importing an archive.

messages.error.invalidSetupCode.text: That setup code isn’t valid. Check it and try again.
messages.error.invalidSetupCode.context: JournalError.invalidSetupCode where the connection flow doesn’t override it. In Connect to a Server it shows as messages.connection.setupCodeIncorrect instead.

messages.error.locked.context: JournalError.locked: an operation found the journals locked or being replaced. Usually suppressed because the lock closes the sheet; may appear in a sheet’s error if the lock and the error race.

messages.error.newerVersion.text: These journals were saved by a newer version of My Journal. Update My Journal to open them.
messages.error.newerVersion.context: JournalError.newerVersion where no more specific text applies. Since build 18 the library problem screen (library.problem.newerVersion.message) replaces it at launch.

messages.error.unauthorized.text: This device no longer has access.
messages.error.unauthorized.context: JournalError.unauthorized outside sync and Devices, for example in Add Device, Change Password or Agent Access. In sync it becomes messages.sync.accessRemoved.

messages.error.unsupportedFormat.text: Update My Journal to edit this entry.
messages.error.unsupportedFormat.context: JournalError.unsupportedFormat: content or a recovery format from a newer version. Also the read-only note under the title of an entry from a newer version (same text). Where an operation fails with it, it appears in that operation’s sheet or the generic alert.

messages.export.archiveFailed.text: Couldn’t export the archive. Try again.

messages.export.archiveNoSpace.text: There isn’t enough space to export the archive. Free up space, then try again.
messages.export.archiveNoSpace.context: Export Archive: the disk is full.

messages.export.archiveSaveFailed.text: Couldn’t save the archive. Try again, or choose another location.
messages.export.archiveSaveFailed.context: Export Archive: writing to the chosen location failed.

messages.export.markdownFailed.text: Couldn’t export your journals. Try again.
messages.export.markdownFailed.context: Export as Markdown: any other failure.

messages.export.markdownNoSpace.text: There isn’t enough space to export your journals. Free up space, then try again.
messages.export.markdownNoSpace.context: Export as Markdown: the disk is full.

messages.export.markdownSaveFailed.text: Couldn’t save the files. Try again, or choose another location.
messages.export.markdownSaveFailed.context: Export as Markdown: writing to the chosen location failed.

messages.failure.certificate.text: Can’t connect securely to the server because its certificate isn’t valid.
messages.failure.certificate.context: Failure message for a network error caused by the server's certificate (sync health: certificate invalid); the first sentence of messages.sync.certificateInvalid.

messages.failure.damagedReading.text: My Journal can’t read your journals on this device. Nothing has been removed. To keep a copy, choose Export Archive in Settings ▸ Backup.
messages.failure.damagedReading.context: Failure message when reading the journals fails because the database is damaged (malformed or not a database, or the store's own validation failed). Same wording as messages.sync.localDataUnreadable.

messages.failure.damagedSaving.text: My Journal can’t save to your journals on this device. Nothing has been removed. To keep a copy, choose Export Archive in Settings ▸ Backup.
messages.failure.damagedSaving.context: Failure message when a change can't be saved because the database is damaged.

messages.failure.full.text: There isn’t enough space on this device. Free up space, then try again.
messages.failure.full.context: Failure message when the device is out of space (database full, out-of-space file error).

messages.failure.keychain.text: My Journal couldn’t use the device key. Try again.
messages.failure.keychain.context: Failure message when the secure store (keychain) fails.

messages.failure.offline.context: Failure message for a network error when the device has no connection (sync health: offline).

messages.failure.other.context: Failure message for an error the app can't classify and that has no text of its own.

messages.failure.temporaryReading.text: My Journal couldn’t use its data on this device right now. Try again.
messages.failure.temporaryReading.context: Failure message when reading fails for any other database, file or unknown reason (busy, locked, device locked, disk problem).

messages.failure.temporarySaving.text: My Journal couldn’t save your changes right now. Try again.
messages.failure.temporarySaving.context: Failure message when a change can't be saved for any other database, file or unknown reason.

messages.failure.unreachable.text: Couldn’t reach the server. Check your connection.
messages.failure.unreachable.context: Failure message for every other network error (sync health: unreachable, unavailable and anything else).

messages.generic.defaultJournalFailed.context: Choosing Settings ▸ General ▸ Default Journal failed to save.

messages.generic.deleteChanged.text: This has changed since you chose to delete it. Check it and try again.
messages.generic.deleteChanged.context: Delete Permanently when the item changed or was restored meanwhile.

messages.generic.deleteNeedsUpdate.text: Update My Journal to delete this.
messages.generic.deleteNeedsUpdate.context: Delete Permanently for an item saved by a newer version.

messages.generic.journalDeleteNeedsUpdat.text: Update My Journal to delete this journal.
messages.generic.journalDeleteNeedsUpdat.context: Delete Journal for a journal saved by a newer version.

messages.generic.journalNamedUnavailable.context: New Entry In ▸ a journal from a template, when that journal left the list meanwhile.

messages.generic.journalUnavailable.text: This journal is no longer available.
messages.generic.journalUnavailable.context: As messages.generic.journalNamedUnavailable when the journal has no name to show; also JournalMergeError.sourceUnavailable in Merge Into….

messages.generic.moveJournalFailed.context: Reordering a journal failed, except when the library record is from a newer version, which shows messages.library.needsUpdate.

messages.generic.pinFailed.context: Pin Entry failed, except when the library record is from a newer version, which shows messages.library.needsUpdate.

messages.generic.templateNeedsReview.text: Review the changes to this template first.
messages.generic.templateNeedsReview.context: Starting an entry from a template that has changes to review.

messages.generic.templateUnavailable.text: This template is no longer available.
messages.generic.templateUnavailable.context: Starting an entry from a template that was deleted or is from a newer version.

messages.generic.unpinFailed.context: Unpin Entry failed, except when the library record is from a newer version, which shows messages.library.needsUpdate.

messages.history.chooseJournal.context: HistoryRecoveryError.destinationUnavailable (Version History restore). In a deletion conflict it shows as messages.conflict.deletion.journalUnavailable.

messages.history.journalChanged.text: This journal has changed. Review its settings again.

messages.history.settingsInUse.text: These settings are already in use.

messages.history.versionUnavailable.text: This version is no longer available. Reload its history.

messages.image.descriptionsNeedSource.text: Edit image descriptions in Markdown source for this entry.
messages.image.descriptionsNeedSource.context: Image Descriptions for an entry whose images can only be edited in View Source.

messages.image.tooLarge.text: Choose an image smaller than 25 MB.
messages.image.tooLarge.context: Insert Image, paste or drop of an image over 25 MB (also the store’s own check).

messages.image.unavailable.text: The image couldn’t be added. It may still be downloading from iCloud. Try again later.
messages.image.unavailable.context: Insert Image of a photo the photo library couldn’t provide.

messages.image.unreadable.text: This file couldn’t be read as an image.
messages.image.unreadable.context: Insert Image of a file that isn’t a readable image.

messages.import.archiveNeedsUpdate.text: Update My Journal to import this archive as new journals. You can still restore it on a device with no journals.
messages.import.archiveNeedsUpdate.context: Import Archive into a device with journals, when the archive has content from a newer version.

messages.import.mergeNeedsUpdate.text: Update My Journal to merge the journals on this device. Some of them were saved by a newer version.
messages.import.mergeNeedsUpdate.context: Merge Journals while connecting, when this device has content from a newer version.

messages.journal.nameTaken.context: JournalNameError.taken, and the Name Taken alert’s announcement.

messages.library.cannotOpen.text: Your journals couldn’t be opened. Quit and reopen My Journal.
messages.library.cannotOpen.context: Unlocking when the journals were never opened and nothing else is shown. Since build 18 a library that fails to open shows the library problem screen and is never locked, so this text is only a guard.

messages.library.deviceKeyUnavailable.text: Your device key is unavailable. Use your recovery key to unlock your journals.
messages.library.deviceKeyUnavailable.context: Launch or unlock: the key that opens the journals isn’t in this device’s keychain (for example after restoring a device backup). The lock screen asks for the password or recovery key.

messages.library.itemUnavailable.text: This item is no longer available.
messages.library.itemUnavailable.context: LibraryError.unavailable. Never shown: pinning and moving journals show messages.generic.pinFailed / unpinFailed / moveJournalFailed instead.

messages.library.needsUpdate.text: Update My Journal to use pinned entries and journal order.
messages.library.needsUpdate.context: Settings ▸ Sync footer while connected, when the synced library record (pins and journal order) was written by a newer version. Also what Pin Entry, Unpin Entry and Move Journal show when the library record is from a newer version; it is the LibraryError.newerVersion description.

messages.library.notOpen.text: Your journals need to open before this can be done.
messages.library.notOpen.context: Connecting to a server, pairing and starting a journal while the library problem screen is showing or Try Again is running. They refuse because they would replace the library.

messages.library.waitingForServer.text: Pinned entries and journal order stay on this device until the server is updated.
messages.library.waitingForServer.context: Settings ▸ Sync footer while connected, when the server can’t store the library record and this device has changes to it.

messages.lifecycle.alreadyDeleted.text: This journal is already in Recently Deleted.

messages.lifecycle.alreadyRestored.text: This journal has already been restored.

messages.lifecycle.changed.text: This journal has changed. Review the entries before deleting it.
messages.lifecycle.changed.context: JournalLifecycleError.changed (Delete Journal sheet and prompt: the entries changed while the alert was open; the generic alert shows this text).

messages.lifecycle.changedContinue.text: This journal has changed. Review it again before continuing.
messages.lifecycle.changedContinue.context: Restore Journal sheet when the journal changed meanwhile.

messages.lifecycle.needsReview.text: These changes need review before you can continue.

messages.lifecycle.unsupportedJournal.text: Update My Journal to make changes to this journal.
messages.lifecycle.unsupportedJournal.context: JournalLifecycleError.unsupportedJournal: a journal saved by a newer version.

messages.merge.newerVersion.text: Update My Journal to merge this journal. Some entries were saved by a newer version.

messages.pairing.codeNotFound.text: That pairing code wasn’t found. Check the code and try again.

messages.pairing.declined.text: Your other device didn’t approve this request.
messages.pairing.declined.context: PairingError.declined, typed-code path (a scanned code shows messages.connection.pairingDeclined).

messages.pairing.deviceOutdated.text: Update My Journal on the new device, then try again.
messages.pairing.deviceOutdated.context: PairingError.deviceOutdated: the new device runs an older version.

messages.pairing.expired.context: PairingError.expired, typed-code path (a scanned code shows messages.connection.pairingExpired).

messages.pairing.insecureCandidate.text: Couldn’t add this device securely. Get a new code on the new device and try again.
messages.pairing.insecureCandidate.context: PairingError.insecureCandidate: the new device’s key failed its check.

messages.pairing.insecureGrant.text: Couldn’t add this device securely. Get a new code and try again.
messages.pairing.insecureGrant.context: PairingError.insecureGrant, typed-code path (a scanned code shows messages.connection.pairingInsecure).

messages.pairing.inviteNewerVersion.text: Update My Journal to use this code.
messages.pairing.inviteNewerVersion.context: PairingInvite.ReadError.newerVersion: a scanned code from a newer version.

messages.pairing.inviteUnreachable.text: This code points to a server this device can’t reach.
messages.pairing.inviteUnreachable.context: PairingInvite.ReadError.unreachableServer: the code’s server address isn’t HTTPS.

messages.pairing.inviteUsed.text: This code was already used. Show a new code on your other device.
messages.pairing.inviteUsed.context: PairingError.inviteUsed: a scanned code was used before.

messages.pairing.noResponse.text: {name} didn’t respond. Get a new code on the new device and try again.
messages.pairing.noResponse.context: PairingError.noResponse: the new device stopped answering. {name} is that device’s name.

messages.pairing.serverOutdated.text: This server needs an update before you can add devices.
messages.pairing.serverOutdated.context: PairingError.serverOutdated: the server doesn’t support check-code pairing.

messages.password.enterMaster.context: Creating an encrypted library without a password (a guard).

messages.password.failed.text: Couldn’t change your password. Your current password still works. Check your connection and try again.

messages.password.notSavedLocally.text: Your password was changed on your server but not on this device. Try again to finish.

messages.password.same.text: Choose a password that’s different from your current password.

messages.password.serverOutdated.text: This server needs an update before you can change your password.

messages.password.unsupported.text: This journal library doesn’t use a master password.

messages.refresh.dateSaved.text: The date was saved. Reopen My Journal to refresh your entries.
messages.refresh.dateSaved.context: The change was committed when Change Date finished, but reading the journals again for display failed.

messages.refresh.encryptionOn.text: Encryption is on, but your journals couldn’t be displayed. Reopen My Journal to try again.
messages.refresh.encryptionOn.context: The change was committed when turning on encryption finished, but reading the journals again for display failed.

messages.refresh.imported.text: Your journals were imported, but couldn’t be displayed. Reopen My Journal to try again.
messages.refresh.imported.context: The change was committed when importing an archive finished, but reading the journals again for display failed.

messages.refresh.itemDeleted.text: The item was deleted, but My Journal couldn’t update the view. Reopen My Journal to continue.
messages.refresh.itemDeleted.context: The change was committed when Delete Permanently finished, but reading the journals again for display failed.

messages.refresh.itemsDeleted.text: The items were deleted, but My Journal couldn’t update the view. Reopen My Journal to continue.
messages.refresh.itemsDeleted.context: The change was committed when Delete All in Recently Deleted finished, but reading the journals again for display failed.

messages.refresh.journalDeleted.text: The journal was deleted, but couldn’t be displayed. Reopen My Journal to try again.
messages.refresh.journalDeleted.context: The change was committed when Delete Journal found the journal already deleted elsewhere, but reading the journals again for display failed.

messages.refresh.journalDeletedView.text: The journal was deleted, but My Journal couldn’t update the view. Reopen My Journal to continue.
messages.refresh.journalDeletedView.context: The change was committed when deleting a journal finished, but reading the journals again for display failed.

messages.refresh.journalRestored.text: The journal was restored, but couldn’t be displayed. Reopen My Journal to try again.
messages.refresh.journalRestored.context: The change was committed when Restore Journal found the journal already restored elsewhere, but reading the journals again for display failed.

messages.refresh.templateRestored.text: The template was restored, but couldn’t be displayed. Reopen My Journal to try again.
messages.refresh.templateRestored.context: The change was committed when restoring a template finished, but reading the journals again for display failed.

messages.restore.alreadyRestored.text: This journal has already been restored. Review the entry before continuing.

messages.restore.changed.text: This entry or journal has changed. Review it again before restoring.

messages.restore.unavailable.text: This entry or journal is no longer available for restoration.

messages.save.before.goBack.text: Your changes aren’t saved yet. Go back to your entry, choose Try Again under Not Saved, then repeat what you were doing.
messages.save.before.goBack.context: JournalError.saveRequired everywhere except the generic alert: inline in the sheet or pane of Move Entry, Create Journal, Version History, Restore Journal, Change Date, Image Descriptions, Export Archive, Export as Markdown, Import Archive and Connect to a Server. The Try Again button is in the Not Saved notice behind the sheet; on the Mac, from the Settings window, “go back” means switching to the journal window. Also the fallback for any presenter that does not say it is the alert.

messages.save.before.tryAgain.text: Your changes aren’t saved yet. Choose Try Again, then repeat what you were doing.
messages.save.before.tryAgain.context: JournalError.saveRequired in the app's generic alert (common.alertTitle), which has a Try Again button while a save has failed: restoring a template, Delete Journal, Delete Permanently, Delete All, and Move Entry when Restore calls it. The wording is chosen when the alert is shown: if the save has succeeded by then, nothing is shown.

messages.save.mac.message.text: Keep this window open and try again, so your changes aren’t lost.

messages.save.mac.title.text: Couldn’t save changes on this Mac.
messages.save.mac.title.context: Mac only: closing the journal window or quitting while the open entry can’t be saved. The window stays open and quitting is cancelled.

messages.save.notSaved.context: The save-failure notice’s status, in red, while saving has failed: first in the entry’s header on iPhone and iPad, below the editor on the Mac.

messages.save.saving.context: Progress label in the save-failure notice while Try Again runs.

messages.server.cancelPairingFailed.context: Cancelling a pairing request failed. Never shown: every caller ignores the failure.

messages.server.imageUnavailable.context: An image download that didn’t answer 200. Never shown: the image is retried on its own.

messages.server.imageUploadFailed.text: Couldn’t upload an image. Try again.
messages.server.imageUploadFailed.context: An image upload answered with an unexpected status. Never shown: the image is retried on its own.

messages.server.noSetupCode.text: The server has no setup code. Restart the server to create a new one.
messages.server.noSetupCode.context: Setting up a server: the server answered 503 to the setup or setup-check request.

messages.server.rateLimited.text: Too many attempts. Try again in a few minutes.
messages.server.rateLimited.context: ServerRateLimited (429) where the screen has no more specific text. In sync it becomes messages.sync.unavailable.

messages.server.responseTooLarge.text: The server sent more data than expected.
messages.server.responseTooLarge.context: A response larger than the client reads (a faulty server). In sync it becomes messages.sync.unexpected.

messages.server.revokeFailed.context: Revoking a device didn’t answer 204. Never shown: Devices shows its own “Couldn’t revoke access…” text and every other caller ignores the failure.

messages.server.syncRequestFailed.text: Couldn’t sync. Your changes are saved on this device.
messages.server.syncRequestFailed.context: A sync request answered with an unexplained 4xx. Never shown as is: sync classifies it as messages.sync.unexpected, and for one record it is retried per item.

messages.server.unanswered.text: Couldn’t reach the server. Check the address and your connection, then try again.
messages.server.unanswered.context: A request the server answered with an unexpected status (not 5xx) that nothing more specific explains, outside sync.

messages.server.unavailable.text: The server isn’t available right now. Try again in a moment.
messages.server.unavailable.context: ServerUnavailable (any 5xx) outside sync: connecting, pairing, setting up a server, Devices, Agent Access. In sync it becomes messages.sync.unavailable.

messages.server.updateForRecoveryFormat.text: Update your server before connecting this journal.
messages.server.updateForRecoveryFormat.context: Setting up a server with a library whose recovery format the server doesn’t list as supported.

messages.sync.accessRemoved.text: This device no longer has access to the server. Your journals are still on this device.
messages.sync.accessRemoved.context: Sync state No access: the same server refuses this device (removed in Devices, or its credential stopped working). Automatic sync stops. Also Settings ▸ Devices’ text when loading devices is refused.

messages.sync.action.checkAgain.context: The single action for Update or fix needed: runs a full sync now.

messages.sync.action.connectAgain.context: The single action when the server was restored or replaced, or this device lost access: opens Connect to a Server at this device’s server, which goes to sign-in.

messages.sync.action.setUpServerAgain.context: The single action when the server isn’t set up: opens Connect to a Server at this device’s server, which goes to the setup-code step.

messages.sync.action.syncNow.context: The single action while syncing normally, or when only one record or image was refused.

messages.sync.announce.failed.context: VoiceOver announcement after a sync the person started didn’t succeed and no message explains it (for example it was cancelled).

messages.sync.announce.synced.context: VoiceOver announcement after Sync Now, Try Again or Check Again finishes with a successful sync and no item-level message.

messages.sync.appUpdateNeeded.text: Update My Journal to sync with this server. Your changes are saved on this device.
messages.sync.appUpdateNeeded.context: Sync state Update or fix needed (update My Journal): the server speaks a newer protocol or recovery format, or the data needs a newer app. Automatic sync stops.

messages.sync.certificateInvalid.text: Can’t connect securely to the server because its certificate isn’t valid. Your changes are saved on this device.
messages.sync.certificateInvalid.context: Sync state Update or fix needed (certificate): no secure connection could be made or the certificate isn’t trusted, expired or not yet valid. Checked again every 5 minutes.

messages.sync.imageRefused.text: Your server didn’t accept an image. Entries that include it are saved on this device.
messages.sync.imageRefused.context: The server refused an image as invalid; entries that include it wait, the rest syncs.

messages.sync.imageTooLarge.text: An image is too large for your server. Entries that include it are saved on this device.
messages.sync.imageTooLarge.context: The server refused an image as too large (413); entries that include it wait, the rest syncs.

messages.sync.localDataUnavailable.text: Couldn’t sync right now. My Journal will try again.
messages.sync.localDataUnavailable.context: Sync state Temporary (this device's data): the local database was busy or locked, the device was locked, or the disk is failing or full. The data is fine. It makes no claim about saving. Retries continue with the usual backoff.

messages.sync.localDataUnreadable.text: My Journal can’t read your journals on this device. Nothing has been removed. To keep a copy, choose Export Archive in Settings ▸ Backup.
messages.sync.localDataUnreadable.context: Sync state Unexpected (this device’s data): this device’s own store couldn’t be read or written during a sync. Retries continue with the usual backoff.

messages.sync.notJournalServer.text: The server address doesn’t lead to a My Journal server. Your changes are saved on this device.
messages.sync.notJournalServer.context: Sync state Update or fix needed (not a journal server): the address answers, but its status isn’t a My Journal status (for example a web page or a captive portal). Checked again every 5 minutes.

messages.sync.offline.text: You’re offline. Your changes are saved on this device and will sync when you’re back online.
messages.sync.offline.context: Sync state Temporary (offline): the last sync failed because this device has no network connection.

messages.sync.pausedForSaveFailure.text: Syncing is paused until your changes are saved. Choose Try Again in the entry.
messages.sync.pausedForSaveFailure.context: Settings ▸ Sync footer while connected and the open entry’s save has failed. Takes priority over every other footer message; Sync Now is dimmed.

messages.sync.recordRefused.text: Your server didn’t accept “{title}”. It’s saved on this device. Edit it to try again.
messages.sync.recordRefused.context: The server refused one record as invalid, or its push failed with a server error 3 times in a row while other requests succeeded; the rest syncs.

messages.sync.recordTooLarge.text: “{title}” is too large to sync. It’s saved on this device. Shorten it or split it into separate entries.
messages.sync.recordTooLarge.context: One entry, journal or template is larger than the server accepts; the rest syncs. {title} is the item’s title, cut to 40 characters with “…”.

messages.sync.serverNotSetUp.text: The server isn’t set up. Your journals are still on this device.
messages.sync.serverNotSetUp.context: Sync state Server changed (not set up): the server was reset and waits for a setup code. Automatic sync stops.

messages.sync.serverReplaced.text: The server was restored or replaced and doesn’t recognize this device. Your journals are still on this device.
messages.sync.serverReplaced.context: Sync state Server changed (restored or replaced): this device was refused and the server now has a different identity. Automatic sync stops.

messages.sync.serverUpdateNeeded.text: The server needs an update before this device can sync. Your changes are saved on this device.
messages.sync.serverUpdateNeeded.context: Sync state Update or fix needed (server): the server lacks an endpoint this app needs (404 or 405 on a sync request). Checked again every 5 minutes.

messages.sync.signInNeeded.text: The server now uses encryption or was replaced. Sign in to keep syncing.
messages.sync.signInNeeded.context: Sync state Needs you: this device was refused and the server’s identity changed to an encrypted library while this library isn’t encrypted (encryption turned on from another device, or the server replaced). Automatic sync stops.

messages.sync.unavailable.text: The server isn’t available right now. Your changes are saved on this device and will sync automatically.
messages.sync.unavailable.context: Sync state Temporary (busy): the server answered with a server error (5xx), asked this device to slow down (429), or sent an answer that couldn’t be parsed.

messages.sync.unexpected.text: Couldn’t sync because of an unexpected problem. Your changes are saved on this device.
messages.sync.unexpected.context: Sync state Unexpected: any other sync failure. Retries continue with the usual backoff.

messages.sync.unreachable.text: Can’t reach the server right now. Your changes are saved on this device and will sync automatically.
messages.sync.unreachable.context: Sync state Temporary (can’t reach): the server refused the connection, timed out, the connection was lost, or its name didn’t resolve.

messages.sync.unreachableTailscale.text: Can’t reach the server right now. If it uses Tailscale, turn on Tailscale on this device. Your changes are saved on this device and will sync automatically.
messages.sync.unreachableTailscale.context: As messages.sync.unreachable, when the server’s host name ends in “.ts.net”.

messages.sync.waiting.text: Saved on this device. Waiting to sync.
messages.sync.waiting.context: Sync Status’s message when it shows but no sync message is held. Only after the app locked and unlocked while a state that needs the person persists, until the next sync (the lock clears the message, not the state).

messages.syncStatus.settings.context: Last item of the Sync Status menu: opens Settings at Sync.

messages.syncStatus.title.context: The Sync Status control’s label, help tag and accessibility label (Mac toolbar button and overflow item; iPhone and iPad submenu of the entry’s … menu).

messages.unavailable.empty.context: Entries list of Unavailable Journals when it is empty.

messages.unavailable.markdownSource.text: This entry uses Markdown that can’t be previewed.
messages.unavailable.markdownSource.context: Under the title of an entry whose Markdown can only be shown and edited as source.

messages.unavailable.restoreJournalNeeds.text: Update My Journal to restore this journal.
messages.unavailable.restoreJournalNeeds.context: A deleted journal saved by a newer version, in Recently Deleted.

messages.writingPaused.connecting.text: Writing is paused while this Mac connects to your server.
messages.writingPaused.connecting.context: Mac journal window, above the editor, while Connect to a Server (in the Settings window) replaces the library; appears after 1 second so a quick connection doesn’t flash it.

messages.writingPaused.connectionFailed.text: This Mac couldn’t finish connecting to your server. Try again, or cancel to keep writing.
messages.writingPaused.connectionFailed.context: Mac journal window while a failed connection’s staged copy waits for Try Again or Cancel in the connection sheet.

messages.writingPaused.encrypting.text: Writing is paused while this Mac encrypts your journals.
messages.writingPaused.encrypting.context: Mac journal window while Turn On Encryption (in Settings) re-encrypts the library.

messages.writingPaused.encryptionUnfinis.text: Your journals are encrypted on {host}, but this Mac couldn’t finish. Free up space, then try again.
messages.writingPaused.encryptionUnfinis.context: Mac journal window when the server was encrypted but this Mac’s copy wasn’t finished.

messages.writingPaused.showConnection.context: Brings the Settings window with the connection sheet forward.

messages.writingPaused.updating.text: My Journal is updating your journals. Try again when it’s finished.
messages.writingPaused.updating.context: Opening an archive (from Finder or Files) while connecting or turning on encryption replaces the library.

settings.about.header.context: Header of the About section at the end of Settings (iPhone, iPad).

settings.about.sourceCode.context: Settings ▸ About link to the repository.

settings.about.support.context: Settings ▸ About link to the support page.

settings.about.version.context: Footer of Settings ▸ About, for example “Version 1.0 (17)”.

settings.about.version.spoken.context: How VoiceOver reads the version footer.

settings.about.versionWithoutBuild.context: Footer of Settings ▸ About when there is no build number.

settings.addDevice.addDetail.text: It will be able to read and sync all your journals.

settings.addDevice.addQuestion.context: Heading when a device that scanned the code asks to join.

settings.addDevice.approve.context: Primary button after comparing check codes; Command-Return.

settings.addDevice.authReason.context: Reason in the system's authentication prompt before approving; on the Mac it completes “My Journal is trying to …”.

settings.addDevice.checkDetail.context: Under the check code on the connected device.

settings.addDevice.checkQuestion.context: Heading above the check code on the connected device.

settings.addDevice.codeField.context: Field for the new device's nine-digit code.

settings.addDevice.codeFooter.text: On the new device, choose Connect to a Server, then Add This Device.
settings.addDevice.codeFooter.context: Footer under the pairing code field.

settings.addDevice.codePlaceholder.context: Placeholder of the pairing code field (shown verbatim).

settings.addDevice.dontAdd.context: Cancel button for a scanned request.

settings.addDevice.enterCodeInstead.context: Button under the QR code switching to typing the new device's code.

settings.addDevice.enterCodeInstead.foot.text: For a Mac or a device that can’t scan the code.

settings.addDevice.error.incomplete.text: Enter the 9-digit code from your new device.
settings.addDevice.error.incomplete.context: Error (and announcement) when the typed code is incomplete.

settings.addDevice.error.unconfirmed.text: Couldn’t confirm that {device} was added. Check the device list.
settings.addDevice.error.unconfirmed.context: Error when the connection failed while approving.

settings.addDevice.error.unverified.text: Couldn’t verify the new device. Show a new code and try again.
settings.addDevice.error.unverified.context: Error when a scanned request doesn't prove it read this code.

settings.addDevice.expired.context: In place of the QR code after ten minutes.

settings.addDevice.httpOnly.text: Other devices can’t connect to {host}. To add devices, connect this device to the server’s HTTPS address.
settings.addDevice.httpOnly.context: Enter Code page when this device uses a plain HTTP address.

settings.addDevice.locked.text: Unlock My Journal to add a device.

settings.addDevice.newDevice.context: Shown instead of a requesting device's name when it's empty.

settings.addDevice.qrLabel.text: Code for adding a new device
settings.addDevice.qrLabel.context: Accessibility label of the QR code.

settings.addDevice.scanInstructions.text: On your iPhone or iPad, choose Connect to a Server, then Scan Code. If it already has journals, Connect to a Server is in Settings > Sync.

settings.addDevice.showNewCode.context: Primary button after the code session expired.

settings.addDevice.stoppedConnecting.context: Notice above a new QR code when a scanned device went away.

settings.addDevice.title.context: Title of the Add Device sheet.

settings.addDevice.unreachable.text: Couldn’t reach the server. Check your connection.
settings.addDevice.unreachable.context: Status under the QR code after three failed checks; also an error when a scanned device stopped and the server couldn't be reached.

settings.addDevice.waitingFor.context: While the new device reveals its key.

settings.agentDetail.activity.context: Row opening, and title of, the agent's recent tool use.

settings.agentDetail.activity.failed.context: Recent Activity when it can't load.

settings.agentDetail.activity.footer.text: My Journal records which tools the agent used, not what it searched for or read.

settings.agentDetail.added.context: Row label with the date the agent was added.

settings.agentDetail.error.changedElsewh.text: This agent was changed on another device. Showing the latest settings.
settings.agentDetail.error.changedElsewh.context: Detail when another device changed the agent first.

settings.agentDetail.error.removeFailed.text: Couldn’t remove the agent. Check your connection and try again.
settings.agentDetail.error.removeFailed.context: Detail when removing an ended agent failed.

settings.agentDetail.error.saveFailed.text: Couldn’t save this change. Check your connection and try again.
settings.agentDetail.error.saveFailed.context: Detail when a change couldn't be saved.

settings.agentDetail.lastJournalHint.text: To stop all access, revoke it.
settings.agentDetail.lastJournalHint.context: Accessibility hint of the last chosen journal's switch.

settings.agentDetail.remove.context: Destructive button once access has ended (no confirmation).

settings.agentDetail.revoke.message.text: {name} won’t be able to read your journals anymore. It keeps anything it already read.

settings.agentDetail.revoked.context: Detail of an agent no longer listed.

settings.agentDetail.status.reconnect.text: Connect again from {client} to reconnect it.
settings.agentDetail.status.reconnect.context: Detail status when the agent needs to reconnect.

settings.agentDetail.tool.other.context: Recent Activity row for an unknown tool.

settings.agents.agentHint.context: Accessibility hint of an agent row.

settings.agents.aiProvider.text: It may send what it reads to its AI provider.
settings.agents.aiProvider.context: End of the journals footer for a new agent and in the detail (starts with a space).

settings.agents.allJournals.context: Journals choice, and an agent row's journals line.

settings.agents.anAgent.context: Shown for a client that sent an empty name.

settings.agents.connect.exposure.text: While an agent has access, anyone who controls {host} could read the journals it reads.
settings.agents.connect.exposure.context: Footer line for encrypted journals on a server that isn't on this computer.

settings.agents.connect.footer.text: Add this address to your agent as an MCP server or custom connector. When the agent asks for access, the request appears here.

settings.agents.connect.header.context: Header of the section with the MCP address.

settings.agents.connect.httpsRequired.text: {host} doesn’t know its HTTPS address. Set its public address before agents can connect.
settings.agents.connect.httpsRequired.context: Agent Access when the server has no HTTPS address; {host} capitalised.

settings.agents.connect.needsUpdate.text: {host} needs an update before agents can connect.
settings.agents.connect.needsUpdate.context: Agent Access when the server lacks agent access; {host} capitalised.

settings.agents.connect.noAccess.text: This device no longer has access to {host}.
settings.agents.connect.noAccess.context: Agent Access when the server refuses this device; followed by Connect Again….

settings.agents.connect.notConnected.text: To let agents read your journals, connect to a server.

settings.agents.connect.publicUrlRequire.text: Set your server’s public address before agents can connect.
settings.agents.connect.publicUrlRequire.context: Agent Access when the server requires a public address.

settings.agents.connect.unreachable.context: Agent Access when the server can't be reached; followed by Try Again.

settings.agents.copied.context: Copy button's title for two seconds after copying.

settings.agents.copiedAnnouncement.context: Announced after copying the MCP address.

settings.agents.detailsUnavailable.text: Details aren’t available on this device.

settings.general.defaultJournal.context: Label of the pop-up choosing where entries created outside a journal go. Sentence case in Mac forms.

settings.general.defaultJournal.footer.text: Used for new entries you create outside a journal.

settings.general.formatAsYouType.context: Switch turning Markdown shortcuts at line starts on or off. Sentence case in Mac forms.

settings.general.formatAsYouType.footer.text: Typing “- ”, “1. ”, “# ” or “> ” at the start of a line formats it. Press Delete right after to keep what you typed.
settings.general.formatAsYouType.footer.context: Footer under Format Markdown as You Type.

settings.libraryProblem.text: Settings are available once your journals open.
settings.libraryProblem.context: Replaces the whole content of Settings while the library problem screen is showing.

settings.lock.failed.text: My Journal couldn’t be unlocked. Try again.
settings.lock.failed.context: Lock screen after the device's authentication failed or couldn't be asked.

settings.lock.pinRetired.text: App Lock now uses {phrase} instead of a PIN.
settings.lock.pinRetired.context: Lock screen note after App Lock moved from the old app PIN, until the first unlock.

text.default: This {device} no longer has a passcode. To use App Lock again, set a passcode, then turn on App Lock in Settings ▸ Privacy.
text.mac: Your Mac user no longer has a login password. To use App Lock again, set a login password, then turn on App Lock in Settings ▸ Privacy.

settings.lock.turnedOff.passcodeRemoved.context: App Lock Is Off message when the passcode or login password was removed.

text.mac: App Lock now uses your login password instead of a PIN. Your Mac user doesn’t have a login password, so App Lock is off.

settings.lock.turnedOff.pinRetired.context: App Lock Is Off message for a device that used the old app PIN and has no passcode.

settings.lock.turnedOff.title.context: Alert after App Lock turned itself off.

settings.lock.unlock.context: Lock screen button unlocking with the typed credential.

settings.lock.unlockWith.context: Lock screen's main button, for example “Unlock with Face ID”.

settings.lock.useCredential.context: Lock screen link after a failed unlock, for example “Use Master Password”.

settings.lock.useMethod.context: Lock screen link back to unlocking with the device.

settings.locked.text: Unlock My Journal to open Settings.
settings.locked.context: Everything Settings shows while My Journal is locked.

settings.pane.agents.context: Settings row or tab for AI agents.

settings.pane.backup.context: Settings row or tab for archives and Markdown export.

settings.pane.devices.context: Settings row or tab listing devices on the server.

settings.pane.general.context: Settings row (iPhone, iPad) or tab (Mac) for the default journal and Markdown formatting. The Mac tab also holds Erase Journals and Settings, so it's called General there.

settings.pane.privacy.context: Settings row or tab for encryption and App Lock.

settings.pane.sync.context: Settings row or tab for the server connection.

settings.password.footer.text: You’ll use this password to sign in on your other devices, restore backups, and recover your journals if you lose your devices. It can’t be reset, so save it in your password manager.
settings.password.footer.context: Footer under a new master password (Connect to a Server, Turn On Encryption).

settings.passwordCheck.authReason.text: set a new password for your journals
settings.passwordCheck.authReason.context: Authentication reason for Forgot Password? (lower case on every platform; on the Mac it completes “My Journal is trying to …”).

settings.passwordCheck.check.context: Primary button of Check Your Password.

settings.passwordCheck.forgot.context: Borderless button after a wrong password, for journals only on this device.

settings.passwordCheck.intro.text: Enter your master password to make sure it’s the one you saved. You’ll need it to open this archive.

settings.passwordCheck.notNow.context: Cancel-position button; the export continues without checking.

settings.passwordCheck.setNew.error.text: Couldn’t set a new password. Your current password still works.
settings.passwordCheck.setNew.error.context: Set New Password when saving failed (also announced).

settings.passwordCheck.setNew.intro.text: Your journals are only on this device, so you can set a new password without the old one. Archives you exported before still need the old password.

settings.passwordCheck.setNew.set.context: Primary button of Set New Password.

settings.passwordCheck.title.context: Title of the one-time password check before the first archive export.

settings.passwordCheck.wrong.context: Under the field after a wrong password (also announced).

settings.privacy.appLock.error.message.context: Message of the App Lock and Lock when inactive save-failure alerts.

settings.privacy.appLock.error.turnOff.context: Alert title when turning App Lock off couldn't be saved.

settings.privacy.appLock.error.turnOn.context: Alert title when turning App Lock on couldn't be saved.

settings.privacy.appLock.footer.context: App Lock footer; {who} is the method phrase with a capital first letter; {automatic} is the Mac's sentence or nothing.

settings.privacy.appLock.footerInactive.context: Mac only, App Lock on with a lock time: inserted as {automatic} (starts with a space).

settings.privacy.appLock.footerSleepOnly.text: It also locks when your Mac sleeps or its screen locks.
settings.privacy.appLock.footerSleepOnly.context: Mac only, App Lock on with Never: inserted as {automatic} (starts with a space).

settings.privacy.appLock.header.context: Header of the App Lock section.

settings.privacy.appLock.inactive.context: Mac only: pop-up in Settings ▸ Privacy ▸ App Lock choosing when App Lock locks after no use.

settings.privacy.appLock.inactive.error.context: Alert title when Lock when inactive couldn't be saved.

text.one: For 1 hour
text.other: For {count} hours

text.other: For {count} minutes

settings.privacy.appLock.noPasscode.context: App Lock footer when the device has no passcode or login password.

settings.privacy.appLock.reason.change.context: Mac: authentication reason when Lock when inactive becomes longer or Never.

settings.privacy.appLock.reason.turnOff.context: Authentication reason when turning App Lock off.

settings.privacy.appLock.reason.turnOn.context: Authentication reason when turning App Lock on.

settings.privacy.appLock.reason.unlock.context: Authentication reason on the lock screen.

settings.privacy.appLock.require.context: App Lock switch, for example “Require Face ID”.

settings.privacy.appLock.unavailable.text: App Lock isn’t available on this device.
settings.privacy.appLock.unavailable.context: App Lock footer when the device can't authenticate its owner.

settings.privacy.changePassword.context: Settings ▸ Privacy button for master-password journals.

settings.privacy.encryption.footerOn.text: Keep your {credential} somewhere safe. It can’t be recovered.
settings.privacy.encryption.footerOn.context: Encryption footer for encrypted journals; {credential} in lower case (master password, recovery key).

settings.privacy.encryption.header.context: Header of the encryption section in Settings ▸ Privacy.

settings.privacy.encryption.on.context: Encryption status. Also: Heading of the last step.

settings.privacy.encryption.turnOn.context: Settings ▸ Privacy button for journals without encryption.

settings.recoveryKey.confirmField.text: Enter the last group to confirm
settings.recoveryKey.confirmField.context: Placeholder of the field for the key's last group.

settings.recoveryKey.copiedNote.text: The copied key is removed from the clipboard after 2 minutes.
settings.recoveryKey.copiedNote.context: Shown (and announced once) after copying the key.

settings.recoveryKey.filename.context: Suggested file name when saving the key.

settings.recoveryKey.notBackup.text: Your recovery key is not a backup. You also need your server data or an exported archive.
settings.recoveryKey.notBackup.context: Note on Keep Your Recovery Key.

settings.recoveryKey.save.context: Button saving the key as a text file.

settings.recoveryKey.saveFailed.context: Alert title when saving the key failed; the message is the system's.

settings.recoveryKey.saved.context: Switch confirming the key was saved.

settings.recoveryKey.title.context: Heading of the screen shown until an early library's recovery key is confirmed.

settings.recoveryKey.warning.text: If you lose access to all your devices and this recovery key, you won’t be able to recover your journals.

settings.scan.cameraDenied.text: Allow camera access in Settings to scan the code.
settings.scan.cameraDenied.context: Scanner text when camera access is denied or restricted.

settings.scan.cameraLabel.context: Accessibility label of the scanner's camera view.

settings.scan.found.context: VoiceOver announcement when a code is read.

settings.scan.instructions.text: Point your camera at the code on your connected device.
settings.scan.instructions.context: Instruction at the bottom of the scanner.

settings.sync.footer.formerMacServer.text: My Journal no longer runs a server on this Mac, so this Mac stopped syncing. Your journals are saved on this Mac. To sync again, connect to a server.
settings.sync.footer.formerMacServer.context: Mac only: Settings ▸ Sync footer after the server earlier Mac versions ran was removed; followed on a new line by Learn More.

settings.sync.footer.howToSetUp.text: How to Set Up a Server
settings.sync.footer.howToSetUp.context: Link in the not-connected Settings ▸ Sync footer to the sync guide. Also: Link in the Set Up Server footer to the guide's server section.

settings.sync.footer.learnMore.context: Link after the former-Mac-server footer, to the guide's section for people who used Use This Mac.

settings.sync.footer.notConnected.text: Your journals are saved on this device.
settings.sync.footer.notConnected.context: Settings ▸ Sync footer when not connected, followed on a new line by the How to Set Up a Server link.

settings.sync.lastSynced.context: Label of the row with the time of the last complete sync.

settings.sync.lastSynced.date.context: Value of Last Synced for older syncs; {day} is the day and abbreviated month (with the year when not this year), for example “12 Sept at 08:03”.

settings.sync.lastSynced.justNow.context: Value of Last Synced under a minute after syncing.

settings.sync.lastSynced.yesterday.context: Value of Last Synced for a sync yesterday; {time} is the short local time.

settings.sync.notOnServerYet.context: Label of the row counting items the server hasn't accepted.

settings.sync.stopSyncing.context: Button in its own section of Settings ▸ Sync while connected.

settings.sync.stopSyncing.confirm.context: Confirming button of the Stop Syncing confirmation (not destructive).

settings.sync.stopSyncing.message.text: Your journals stay on this device. To sync again later, choose Connect to a Server in Settings > Sync.
settings.sync.stopSyncing.message.context: Message of the Stop Syncing confirmation.

text.one: 1 item that isn’t on the server yet will stay only on this device until then.
text.other: {count} items that aren’t on the server yet will stay only on this device until then.

settings.sync.stopSyncing.messageUnsent.context: Appended, after a space, to the Stop Syncing message when items haven't reached the server.

settings.sync.stopSyncing.title.context: Title of the Stop Syncing confirmation; {host} is the server's host, with the port when not the default.

settings.sync.syncing.context: Value of Last Synced while a sync the person started runs. Also: Status while everything is received from the server before encrypting.

settings.title.context: Title of the Settings sheet (iPhone, iPad).
